related.title: PACE 海洋與大氣觀測
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付岸線、基準、體積估算與流量不可識別的說明。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver shorelines, datum, volume estimate and explicit limits on discharge inference.
related.difference: 用合成藍綠波段比值研究海色特徵，分離大氣殘差與水體訊號。
related.differenceEn: Use a synthetic blue/green ratio to study ocean-colour features while separating atmospheric residuals from water signals.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 用起始面積法與梯形法各算一次，畫面積對水位圖下面積。
計算藍綠比，再將兩波段同乘 1.1，驗證比值不變。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Compute starting-area and trapezoidal estimates and plot area under the area-level curve.
Calculate the ratio, multiply both bands by 1.1 and verify cancellation.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Euclid 宇宙學望遠鏡
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付岸線、基準、體積估算與流量不可識別的說明。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver shorelines, datum, volume estimate and explicit limits on discharge inference.
related.difference: 在弱透鏡教學模型中去除點擴散函數的形狀偏差，評估平均形狀的系統誤差。
related.differenceEn: Remove PSF shape bias in a teaching weak-lensing model and assess systematic error in mean galaxy shape.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 用起始面積法與梯形法各算一次，畫面積對水位圖下面積。
算 PSF 洩漏項 0.006，從觀測形狀扣除，畫各項向量。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Compute starting-area and trapezoidal estimates and plot area under the area-level curve.
Calculate leakage 0.006,subtract it and draw component vectors.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
